comments.author: Stanley Virgint
comments.text: Hey Product Hunt! 👋 The Problem There's a wave of texting agents coming, each with its own use case, personality, and charm. But how do you actually find them? Bookmarking them on X the one time you spot them in your feed? Not anymore. Introducing Agent Store Agent Store is the #1 marketplace for texting agents , all verified and collectively used by millions of people. Since launch, our ecosystem has grown to 137 texting agents in 3 months , and we expect that to reach several million over the coming years. 🧳 Travel companions 💘 Matchmakers 🎲 Betting copilots 🧑‍💼 Recruiters 🩺 Health coaches All living as phone numbers you text instead of apps you install. How it works Browse by category or trending, and text any agent that speaks to you. Or just text the Agent Store itself at +1 (424) 278-0248 to explore the marketplace and get weekly updates on new agents, right from your messages. Get involved If you're building one and don't see it listed, there's a submit link on the site. Come join us and get free distribution for your agent in the process. If you'd like to be a contributor, reach out and join us!

comments.author: Abdul Rehman
comments.text: congratulation on launch @stannno btw, a quick question, does it cost anything per text or is it completely free to message these agents?

comments.author: Stanley Virgint
comments.text: @abod_rehman  Thanks abdul! It works a lot like the iOS App Store. Most agents are free to text, and some offer in-agent purchases or subscriptions.

comments.author: Himani Sah
comments.text: How do you prevent low-quality or spamming agents from entering the marketplace? Essentially, I am asking about the quality of control.

comments.author: Stanley Virgint
comments.text: @himani_sah1  This is where we have humans in the loop - to keep the ecosystem healthy. Each is vetted by a collection of people.

comments.author: Divya Kothari
comments.text: What's the verification and approval process for agents at the Agent Store? Congrats on the launch!

comments.author: Stanley Virgint
comments.text: @divya_kothari1 it's quick! just submit here: https://www.imessage.store/submit . Most are live within less then 24hrs if it passes standard safety and usability checks

comments.author: Angelo Bram
comments.text: Could builders get analytics on how many people discover their agent through Agent Store?

comments.author: Boyuan Deng
comments.text: Team, how do one even find the right agent for what they need, is there a search or just a big list?

comments.author: Stanley Virgint
comments.text: @boyuan_deng1  You can text the dedicated Agent Store phone number here: +1 (424) 278-0248‬ to explore all the agents easily . We also hand curate new agents every Monday and share them over text, similar to app features on the iOS app store.

comments.author: Fletcher Oliver
comments.text: Do you see Agent Store becoming a discovery layer for most texting agents?

comments.author: Stanley Virgint
comments.text: @fletcher_oliver  yeah that's the plan! right now there's no real way to find texting agents besides word of mouth, so we want to be the market place to help both humans and agents explore
